title: Mason City, IA is a suprisingly theatre gem #themusicman #thesoundofm...
transcript: where in the world will we see a show today first up pit stop to Mason City Iowa to go see some really cool puppets by one of my favourite puppet designers Bob Baird was a famous puppet designer primarily known for designing marionettes like these from The Lonely Goatheard in The Sound of music he also designed for one of my favourite unknown Broadway musicals Flahooley though the Flahooley doll is not on display sadly a lot of his puppets are on display at the MacNider Art Museum which is free to enter and literally across the street in Mason City which is the birthplace of composer Meredith Wilson there's an entire Meredith Wilson Museum and it includes this is complete replica of River City from the original Warner Brothers film you know what they say you really ought to give Iowa a try okay let's see if we can get to Minneapolis uh for the show that I definitely don't have tickets to hopefully it doesn't sell out
